latency_analysis.reason: Meaningful deadline sensitivity is measured, but no causal evidence establishes a safe prompt/token change as an improvement. No optimization was attempted; preserve the frozen prompt/model/budgets and report WEAK rather than claiming an unmeasured gain.
latency_analysis.percentile_caveat: P95 is a descriptive nearest-rank statistic; with n=12 it equals the maximum and is not a stable population estimate. Timeout durations are censored observations, not completed inference latency.
latency_analysis.environment_caveat: Single Windows CPU-model session, sequential live inference, not a controlled benchmark; some independent deterministic checks/builds overlapped on the same host. No load test or concurrency against real phi-4-mini.
